backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: add a small incremental scalar only to Space trend_long signals whose closed 10d forward profile passes the same-theme replacement-strength bucket and whose event seed profile has company_release customer_win.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260514-009 accepted same-theme replacement-strength trend-only risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-016 rejected same-theme replacement-strength trend plus peer-leader interaction.
exp-20260514-024 accepted same-theme replacement-strength trend plus IWM-leader interaction at 1.025x.
No prior record found for same-theme replacement-strength trend plus company-release customer-win interaction.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the additional company-source trend risk scalar changes; accepted exp-024 stack and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: Space replacement-strength allocation should be strongest when closed 10d same-theme replacement value, trend continuation, and a company-release customer-win catalyst all agree. On top of accepted exp-20260514-024, a single extra company-source trend scalar tests that catalyst-quality interaction without adding tickers, broad filters, LLM authority, lifecycle rules, or live Space slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
The company-release slice is narrow and should stay conservative even if accepted.
Forward replacement profiles are closed 2026 outcomes and should not be treated as proof for live routing.
next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off Space metadata/helper; keep live Space slots at zero until forward replacement evidence broadens.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for trend_long signals in the accepted forward same-theme replacement-strength bucket when the production event seed profile includes company_release customer_win
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin; VSAT/IRDM and benchmark-laggard candidate expansion failed the gate; 5d confirmation and peer-leader trend variants were rejected. This keeps the candidate pool fixed and tests a production-visible source-quality interaction with replacement value.
